name: Jira ticket to Gherkin test scenarios

nodes.name: Set issue key
nodes.notes: Replace with a Jira Trigger node, or a Schedule Trigger plus a JQL search, once you want this to run unattended. Keeping it manual while you tune the prompt means you are not spamming tickets with draft scenarios.

nodes.name: Generate Gherkin
nodes.notes: A plain HTTP Request node rather than a LangChain AI node, deliberately. It is version-stable, it is obvious what is being sent, and temperature 0 is explicit. The system prompt lives in an n8n variable so it can be changed without editing the workflow. Store the system prompt in Settings > Variables as gherkinSystemPrompt, using the text in prompts/system-prompt.md.
